Statistical analysis involved Student's t-test and one-way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD test.
outputs.explanation: The bar graphs show error bars (mean ± SD) and statistical comparisons, so replication is clearly involved. A number is given ('N=4') on the mitochondrial-fraction graph, but neither the caption nor the panel states what this N represents (e.g., number of mice, independent blots, or technical repeats), and it is unclear whether N=4 also applies to the nuclear and cytosolic quantifications shown alongside it. The type of replicate is therefore not reported.
